tasks.subject: Task 1: Preflight mount-gate primitives
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A new `preflight.py` exposing the typed exceptions and the mount-gate functions, fully unit-tested, wired to nothing yet.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/irsync/preflight.py`
- Test: `tests/test_preflight.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `mount_gate_root` returns the first path component below `base_dir`, or `None` for paths outside `base_dir` and for `base_dir` itself
- [ ] `check_mounted` returns silently for `str` endpoints (remotes)
- [ ] `check_mounted` raises `EndpointNotMounted` when the gate component is not a mountpoint
- [ ] `check_mounted` with `gate_outside_base=True` checks the endpoint itself when it is outside `base_dir`
- [ ] `mypy --strict` passes on the new module

**Verify:** `pixi run python -m pytest tests/test_preflight.py -v`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/irsync/preflight.py", "tests/test_preflight.py"], "verifyCommand": "pixi run python -m pytest tests/test_preflight.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["mount_gate_root returns first component below base_dir or None", "check_mounted exempts str/remote endpoints", "check_mounted raises EndpointNotMounted for unmounted gate path", "gate_outside_base=True checks the endpoint itself", "mypy strict passes"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Wire mount gate into backup flow
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The mount gate runs before any file is created, `ALL` treats an unmounted drive as a skip, and `--allow-unmounted` / `--require-mount` control it.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/irsync/backup.py` (`run_backup`, `_run_snapshot_only`, `run_all_backups`)
- Modify: `src/irsync/cli.py` (new flags)
- Modify: `tests/test_backup.py` (`_args` defaults, new tests)
- Modify: `tests/test_integration.py` (`_args` defaults only)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] The gate runs after `resolve_endpoints` and BEFORE `_source_lock`
- [ ] `--allow-unmounted` bypasses the gate; `--require-mount` extends it outside `base_dir`
- [ ] `run_all_backups` records an unmounted drive as missing/skipped and still returns 0
- [ ] `_run_snapshot_only` performs the same check before its own lock

**Verify:** `pixi run python -m pytest tests/test_backup.py -v -k "MountGate or RunAllBackups"`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/irsync/backup.py", "src/irsync/cli.py", "tests/test_backup.py", "tests/test_integration.py"], "verifyCommand": "pixi run python -m pytest tests/test_backup.py -v -k \"MountGate or RunAllBackups\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["gate runs before _source_lock; no lockfile written on refusal", "--allow-unmounted bypasses, --require-mount extends", "run_all_backups counts unmounted as missing and returns 0", "_run_snapshot_only checks before its lock"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Destination gate for baseline-less runs
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A first-backup-shaped run refuses when the destination already holds data, closing hazard A for explicit-path runs that never touch `base_dir`.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/irsync/preflight.py` (add `foreign_dest_entries`)
- Modify: `src/irsync/backup.py` (`_run_backup_for_endpoints`)
- Modify: `src/irsync/cli.py` (`--allow-nonempty-dest`)
- Modify: `tests/test_preflight.py`, `tests/test_backup.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `foreign_dest_entries` excludes irsync's reserved namespace
- [ ] `foreign_dest_entries` raises `UnsafeDestination` when the destination cannot be read
- [ ] A baseline-less run into a non-empty destination returns `EXIT_REFUSED` and leaves the destination intact
- [ ] `--allow-nonempty-dest` permits the run

**Verify:** `pixi run python -m pytest tests/test_preflight.py tests/test_backup.py -v -k "Foreign or DestinationGate"`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/irsync/preflight.py", "src/irsync/backup.py", "src/irsync/cli.py", "tests/test_preflight.py", "tests/test_backup.py"], "verifyCommand": "pixi run python -m pytest tests/test_preflight.py tests/test_backup.py -v -k \"Foreign or DestinationGate\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["reserved namespace excluded from foreign entries", "unreadable destination raises UnsafeDestination", "baseline-less run into non-empty dest returns EXIT_REFUSED and preserves data", "--allow-nonempty-dest permits the run"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: First-run preview
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A run with no baseline shows what it is about to do before asking for confirmation.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/irsync/backup.py` (`_format_first_run_preview`, `_run_backup_for_endpoints`)
- Modify: `tests/test_backup.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] The summary names the source, its entry count and total size, the destination, and its existing-entry count
- [ ] The summary states that non-matching destination content will be deleted
- [ ] Under `--yes` it reaches stdout (AD-7); interactively it goes through the pager
- [ ] Counts come from `fresh_rows` and the Task 3 `iterdir` — no extra tree scan

**Verify:** `pixi run python -m pytest tests/test_backup.py -v -k FirstRunPreview`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/irsync/backup.py", "tests/test_backup.py"], "verifyCommand": "pixi run python -m pytest tests/test_backup.py -v -k FirstRunPreview", "acceptanceCriteria": ["summary names source, entry count, size, destination, existing entries", "summary states deletion consequence", "reaches stdout under --yes, pager interactively", "no extra tree scan"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Clean refusals instead of tracebacks
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Missing rsync, a read-only source root, and a missing source path all produce a logged refusal and exit 2 rather than a stack trace.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/irsync/preflight.py` (`check_rsync_available`)
- Modify: `src/irsync/backup.py` (`run_backup`, `_source_lock` call sites)
- Modify: `src/irsync/cli.py` (`main` exception boundary)
- Modify: `tests/test_preflight.py`, `tests/test_backup.py`, `tests/test_cli.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `shutil.which("rsync")` returning `None` produces `EXIT_REFUSED` with an actionable message
- [ ] A read-only source root produces `EXIT_REFUSED`, not `PermissionError`
- [ ] A missing source path in a single-drive run produces `EXIT_REFUSED`, not a traceback
- [ ] `run_all_backups` still catches `FileNotFoundError` first

**Verify:** `pixi run python -m pytest tests/test_backup.py tests/test_preflight.py -v -k "CleanRefusal or RsyncAvailable"`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/irsync/preflight.py", "src/irsync/backup.py", "src/irsync/cli.py", "tests/test_preflight.py", "tests/test_backup.py", "tests/test_cli.py"], "verifyCommand": "pixi run python -m pytest tests/test_backup.py tests/test_preflight.py -v -k \"CleanRefusal or RsyncAvailable\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["missing rsync yields EXIT_REFUSED", "read-only source root yields EXIT_REFUSED not PermissionError", "missing source path exits 2 with no traceback", "ALL still skips absent drives"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Warn on skipped nested mounts
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A filesystem mounted inside the source is reported rather than silently excluded from the backup.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/irsync/snapshot.py` (`snapshot_tree`, new `_crosses_boundary` helper)
- Modify: `tests/test_snapshot.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `_crosses_boundary` returns True only when `xdev` is on and the device differs
- [ ] `snapshot_tree` emits exactly one aggregated warning naming the count and the first few paths
- [ ] No warning when nothing is skipped
- [ ] `snapshot_tree`'s signature and return type are unchanged

**Verify:** `pixi run python -m pytest tests/test_snapshot.py -v -k Boundary`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/irsync/snapshot.py", "tests/test_snapshot.py"], "verifyCommand": "pixi run python -m pytest tests/test_snapshot.py -v -k Boundary", "acceptanceCriteria": ["_crosses_boundary true only when xdev and device differs", "one aggregated warning with count and sample paths", "no warning when nothing skipped", "snapshot_tree signature unchanged"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: Split --force from the deletion guard
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `--force` means only "run even though nothing changed"; bypassing the catastrophic-delete guard requires `--allow-massive-delete`.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/irsync/backup.py:398` (the guard condition)
- Modify: `src/irsync/cli.py` (new flag, conflict check)
- Modify: `tests/test_backup.py` (`TestCatastrophicDiffSanityCheck`)
- Modify: `tests/test_cli.py` (conflict test)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `--force` alone no longer bypasses the >50% deletion refusal
- [ ] `--allow-massive-delete` bypasses it
- [ ] `--force` still defeats the no-change short-circuit
- [ ] `--allow-massive-delete` with `--no-snapshot` is rejected at parse time

**Verify:** `pixi run python -m pytest tests/test_backup.py tests/test_cli.py -v -k "Catastrophic or Force or massive"`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/irsync/backup.py", "src/irsync/cli.py", "tests/test_backup.py", "tests/test_cli.py"], "verifyCommand": "pixi run python -m pytest tests/test_backup.py tests/test_cli.py -v -k \"Catastrophic or Force or massive\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["--force alone no longer bypasses the 50% guard", "--allow-massive-delete bypasses it", "--force still defeats the no-change short-circuit", "--allow-massive-delete with --no-snapshot rejected at parse time"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```
